key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% with passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of perovskite solar cells require structured measurement tables, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Test structured SQL access using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical literature and 50.8% on prospective literature, with particular benefits for extrema, distributions, and filtered record counts.
watch_item: Accuracy remains near 51%, and deployment depends on extracting and maintaining reliable structured device records.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
